0022600228.text: The Detroit Pistons (6-3, 1st in the Central and 3rd in the East) visit the Washington Wizards (4-6, 9th in the East), with Detroit 4-1 on the road and on a two-game losing streak while Washington is on a three-game skid. Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 117-95 win in Washington on March 19, 2026.
